questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'I really enjoyed the concert,' she said to me.
options: She said that she had enjoyed the concert.
She said to me that she had enjoyed the concert.
She said that she had really enjoyed the concert.
She said to me that she had really enjoyed the concert.
questions.answer: She said to me that she had really enjoyed the concert.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice?
options: The book was written by a famous author last year.
The book was written last year by a famous author.
The book was written by a famous author, and it was published last year.
The book was written last year, and it was published by a famous author.
questions.answer: The book was written last year by a famous author.

questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: If I _____ more time, I would travel around the world.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'I haven't seen her for years,' he said.
options: He said that he hadn't seen her for years.
He said that he didn't see her for years.
He said that he had not seen her for years.
He said that he didn't see her for years.
questions.answer: He said that he had not seen her for years.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the third conditional?
options: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would pass the exam.
If I studied harder, I would pass the exam.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
